stages.name: Naive Correlation Scan
stages.description: Undifferenced Pearson correlation, no multiple-testing correction
stages.role_in_pipeline: Baseline showing that raw correlation flags all pairs as significant regardless of true causal structure
stages.data_framework: d028 per-method FPR analysis (8 unidirectional canary->downstream pairs, seed 42)

summary.interpretation: Naive Pearson is uninformative: 100% sig rate even at null control

0.00.note: Null control (zero canary injection) - all 8 significant = 100% FPR

1.00.note: 4-seed data: 32/32 per-seed tests also all significant

case_studies.case: alpha=0.0 null control: 100% false positive rate
case_studies.details: At alpha=0.0 (zero canary injection), naive Pearson reports 8/8 pairs significant (p < 0.05). Textbook spurious regression: shared non-stationarity in iterative training drives co-movement absent any causal link.

stages.name: First-Differencing
stages.description: First-differenced cross-correlation removes shared non-stationary trends
stages.role_in_pipeline: Eliminates spurious associations driven by common training trends, but retains residual FP from correlated innovations
stages.data_framework: d028 per-method FPR analysis (8 unidirectional pairs, seed 42)

summary.reduction_from_naive: Eliminates 0-75% of naive-significant pairs depending on alpha

0.00.note: Still 50% FPR raw - differencing alone is insufficient

0.50.note: Signal strong enough to survive differencing

null_control_pair_detail.note: Differencing removes all ECE->downstream spurious correlations at null but leaves all 4 token_entropy->downstream as residual FP

case_studies.details: At null control, differencing reduces naive 8/8 sig to 4/8 sig (FPR=50% raw, 37.5% FDR). Surviving FP are all token_entropy->downstream. ECE->downstream spurious links are successfully eliminated.
At low canary fraction (25%), differencing removes most naive associations, leaving only 2/8 significant. Shows differencing is more effective at low signal-to-noise.

case_studies.case: Method ablation at alpha=1.0: differenced 14/16 sig vs naive 16/16
case_studies.details: At full canary injection with 4 seeds, differencing eliminates 2/16 pairs that naive finds significant. Source: method_ablation.json summary.

stages.name: Permutation Granger + BH FDR
stages.description: Non-parametric Granger causality (differenced series, 5000 permutations) with Benjamini-Hochberg FDR correction across all tests
stages.role_in_pipeline: Tests directional predictability beyond autocorrelation; FDR controls family-wise false discovery rate
stages.data_framework: v6 cross-alpha (5 alphas x 8 bidirectional directions = 40 tests, BH-corrected together)

null_control_validation.note: Permutation Granger achieves 0% FPR at null control (cf. naive 100%, differenced 50%)

0.00.note: All 8 directions correctly non-significant at null control

0.25.note: All 3 raw-sig eliminated by FDR; includes 2 reverse directions

case_studies.case: v6: FDR reduces raw 14/40 to 6/40 significant tests
case_studies.details: Of 40 tests (5 alphas x 8 directions), 14 show raw p<0.05 but only 6 survive BH correction. All 6 survivors are at high-canary regimes (alpha>=0.75) and involve entropy/ECE -> diversity directions only. No reverse (downstream->canary) directions survive.

case_studies.case: v4 vs v6: adding alpha=0.75 changes FDR landscape
case_studies.details: v4 (32 tests): raw 10/32 -> FDR 1/32 (only ECE->d1 @ alpha=1.0 survives). v6 (40 tests): raw 14/40 -> FDR 6/40. Adding alpha=0.75 contributes 4 raw-sig tests (3 survive FDR), and redistributed BH thresholds allow 2 more alpha=1.0 tests to pass.
At alpha=0.0, permutation Granger correctly rejects all 8 directions (0/8 sig), while naive gives 100% FP and differenced gives 50% FP. This validates the method's specificity.

stages.name: Multi-seed Replication
stages.description: Cross-seed consistency check: requires >=4/5 methods significant across >=3/4 independent seeds
stages.role_in_pipeline: Guards against seed-specific artifacts by requiring cross-seed replication

data_availability.alpha_0.75: Single-seed only (method agreement, no seed replication)

summary.note: At alpha=1.0, multi-seed replication (4 seeds) filters 10/16 pairs that pass naive correlation down to 6 robust pairs. Key value: catches seed-specific artifacts (e.g. token_entropy->perplexity passes single-seed method agreement but fails cross-seed replication, D017).

stages.d038_compliance: Cross-alpha robust counts (e.g. alpha=0.75 single-seed vs alpha=1.0 multi-seed) MUST NOT be directly compared as overestimation rates — differences confound alpha level with evaluation standard (constraint #27).

robust_pairs_alpha100.note: TY fails (2/4 seeds) but other 4 methods pass

eliminated_pairs_alpha100.elimination_reason: Only naive + threshold pass; differenced, TY, perm all fail
Only naive + differenced; no causal methods pass

seed_artifact_examples.description: Pairs where single-seed method agreement is misleading — multi-seed replication reveals instability

token_entropy_perplexity_d017.multi_seed_4seeds_result: 3/5 methods pass: threshold_onset 0/4 seeds, perm_granger 0/4 seeds -> NOT ROBUST
token_entropy_perplexity_d017.interpretation: threshold_onset and perm_granger significance at seed=42 was a seed-specific artifact; two other seeds show non-significance for these methods
token_entropy_perplexity_d017.lesson: Method agreement alone (without seed replication) inflates robustness classification

ece_perplexity.multi_seed_4seeds_result: 3/5 methods pass: TY 0/4 seeds, perm_granger 0/4 seeds -> NOT ROBUST

effective_rank_diversity.single_seed_s42: effective_rank->d1/d2/d3 all pass >=4/5 methods at alpha=0.75
effective_rank_diversity.multi_seed_alpha100: Only 1-2 seeds for causal methods -> NOT ROBUST
effective_rank_diversity.note: effective_rank as canary metric fails entirely under multi-seed scrutiny

stages.alpha_075_vs_100_caveat: alpha=0.75 has only single-seed data (method agreement). alpha=1.0 has 4-seed data (full consensus). These use DIFFERENT evaluation standards and CANNOT be directly compared to derive an overestimation rate (D038 constraint #27). Proper comparison requires same-standard evaluation, pending D026 multi-seed for alpha<=0.50.

cross_alpha_regime_summary.note: WARNING (D038 #27): alpha<1.0 uses single-seed method agreement, alpha=1.0 uses 4-seed full consensus. These numbers use DIFFERENT standards and are NOT directly comparable. The apparent drop from 11 (alpha=0.75) to 6 (alpha=1.0) confounds alpha level with evaluation rigor.

stages.constraint_c001: DO NOT cite TY cross-alpha trends from Phase 2 single-seed data. D026 multi-seed needed to confirm TY non-monotonic pattern (0%->62.5%->0%->59.4%) is reproducible vs noise.
stages.pending: D026 multi-seed experiments for alpha=0.25/0.50 still in progress

case_studies.case: Multi-seed replication filters seed-specific artifacts at alpha=1.0
case_studies.details: At alpha=1.0, 16/16 pairs pass naive correlation but only 6/16 survive the full consensus pipeline (>=4/5 methods, >=3/4 seeds). The 10 eliminated pairs include cases where individual methods show seed-specific significance that does not replicate.

case_studies.case: D017 exemplar: token_entropy->perplexity (seed-specific artifact, same alpha)
case_studies.details: At alpha=1.0, seed=42 shows 4/5 method agreement for token_entropy->perplexity. But across 4 seeds: threshold_onset achieves significance in 0/4 seeds, perm_granger in 0/4 seeds. Only 3/5 methods replicate -> NOT ROBUST. This demonstrates multi-seed replication catching a seed-specific artifact without confounding alpha levels.

funnel_A_null_control.description: Pipeline filtering at alpha=0.0 (null control) - all significance is FP
funnel_A_null_control.note: Pipeline correctly rejects all FP at null control by Stage 3

funnel_B_cross_alpha_granger.description: Granger + FDR filtering across all alphas

funnel_C_method_consensus.description: Full pipeline at alpha=1.0 with 4-seed consensus
funnel_C_method_consensus.note: At alpha=1.0, Stages 3 and 4 converge to the same 6 pairs. Multi-seed replication's incremental value at alpha=1.0 is catching within-alpha seed artifacts (e.g. D017 token_entropy->ppl). Its value at lower alphas pending D026 data.
